# U.S. Geological Survey

> > The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) provides science about the natural hazards that threaten lives, the natural resources we rely on, the health of our ecosystems and environment, and the impacts of climate and land-use change.

USGS operates volcano observatories monitoring active volcanic systems including Yellowstone, Mount St. Helens, Mount Rainier, and Long Valley Caldera, alongside water science centers, fisheries research facilities, and specialized laboratories for spectroscopy, gas hydrates, and bird banding. The agency provides critical emergency response capabilities, fire danger forecasting, and real-time monitoring of earthquakes, volcanic activity, and environmental hazards across the United States and its territories.

## Key Topics

- Volcano monitoring and volcanic hazards
- Yellowstone, Mount St. Helens, Mount Rainier
- Long Valley Caldera, Lassen Volcanic Center, Mammoth Mountain
- California volcanoes (Clear Lake, Medicine Lake, Mono-Inyo Craters)
- Earthquake data and seismic monitoring
- Emergency operations and disaster response
- Fire danger forecasting and wildfire risk
- Water science and streamflow monitoring
- Fisheries research and fish health
- Remote sensing and hyperspectral imaging
- Bird banding and wildlife conservation
- Geologic mapping and mineral resources
- Gas hydrates and energy resources
- Mariana Islands submarine volcanoes

## Volcano Observatories & Monitoring

- [California Volcano Observatory](https://www.usgs.gov/observatories/calvo): Monitors California volcanoes including Clear Lake & Coso Volcanic Fields
- [Weekly Volcano Update](https://www.usgs.gov/volcanoes/weekly-update): Weekly volcano activity updates for Yellowstone, Mt. St. Helens & US volcanoes
- [Anatahan Volcano](https://www.usgs.gov/volcanoes/anatahan): Anatahan volcano monitoring: earthquakes, lava flows, and activity data
- [Medicine Lake Volcano](https://www.usgs.gov/volcanoes/medicine-lake): Medicine Lake volcano monitoring: earthquake data & hazard assessments
- [Daikoku Seamount](https://www.usgs.gov/volcanoes/daikoku-seamount): Daikoku Seamount submarine volcano monitoring in Mariana Islands
- [South Sarigan Seamount](https://www.usgs.gov/volcanoes/south-sarigan-seamount): South Sarigan Seamount volcano monitoring in Mariana Islands region

## Emergency Response & Hazards

- [Emergency Operations Portal](https://www.usgs.gov/emergency-operations-portal): Emergency response hub providing geospatial imagery for disaster events
- [Fire Danger Forecast](https://www.usgs.gov/fire-danger-forecast): Wildfire risk forecasting using satellite data and fire potential indices
- [Hurricane Dorian](https://www.usgs.gov/special-topics/hurricane-dorian): Hurricane Dorian coastal impacts: storm tide sensors & beach erosion data

## Science Centers & Research Programs

- [Geology, Minerals, Energy, and Geophysics Science Center](https://www.usgs.gov/centers/gmeg): GMEG Science Center: geologic mapping, mineral & energy resources research
- [Pennsylvania Water Science Center](https://www.usgs.gov/centers/pennsylvania-water-science-center): PA water monitoring: streamflow, groundwater & Susquehanna River data
- [Bird Banding Laboratory](https://www.usgs.gov/labs/bird-banding-laboratory): North American Bird Banding Program: permits, data & wildlife conservation
- [Spectroscopy Lab](https://www.usgs.gov/labs/spectroscopy-lab): Spectroscopy Lab: hyperspectral imaging & digital spectral libraries
- [Fish Health Program](https://www.usgs.gov/labs/fish-health-program): Fish Health Program: aquatic disease surveillance & salmon research
- [Gas Hydrates Project Hydrate Pressure Core Analysis Laboratory](https://www.usgs.gov/labs/gas-hydrates-project-hydrate-pressure-core-analysis-laboratory): HyPrCAL: gas hydrates research & pressure core analysis facility

## Regional Facilities & Locations

- [Maryland Locations](https://www.usgs.gov/states/maryland): Maryland facilities directory: science centers & field stations
- [Arizona Locations](https://www.usgs.gov/states/arizona): Arizona facilities directory: science centers & volcanic observatories
- [Montana Locations](https://www.usgs.gov/states/montana): Montana facilities directory: science centers & field stations map

## Newsletters & Updates

- [Something Fishy from the Western Fisheries Research Center](https://www.usgs.gov/something-fishy-western-fisheries-research-center): Quarterly newsletter from Western Fisheries Research Center
- [Great Lakes Science Waves](https://www.usgs.gov/great-lakes-science-waves): Great Lakes Science Center newsletter with research highlights & field work
